premises: Pd@PdAg icosahedra and {111} truncated bi-pyramids have identical composition and facets but different surface strains (~2.1% vs. ~0.3%)
Lower surface strain (0.3%) downshifts the d-band center of PdAg alloys relative to higher strain (2.1%)
Downshifted d-band center weakens adsorption of the poisoning intermediate *CH3CO
Weaker *CH3CO binding enhances ethanol oxidation activity, selectivity, and durability
